propositions: Unify Jira-specific operator surface into one provider-neutral bridge command surface while retaining all live legacy contracts and compatibility adapters.
Expose canonical bridge operations (setup, check-access, fsck, status, preview, sync, pause, resume) through shared Python library, CLI, and MCP server interfaces with identical semantics.
Guarantee argument-less reconcile remains dry-run (safe default) while argument-less bridge sync is live (mutating canonical form).
Implement durable, mixed-version-safe pause state with reason tracking and remove gh CLI dependency from destructive repair and normal operations.
Support runner-neutral execution across local, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments with shared Python-owned core, unified exit codes (0/1/2), and legacy translations (3/4/75).
Unify tickets-branch delivery under Python-owned src/rebar/_store/push.py with strict failure classification and terminal push budget, eliminating workflow-local CAS loops.
